_readme: Source for the product cards on /lineup/. Edit here, then run python3 scripts/build-lineup.py. Text is HTML: ’ for apostrophes, · between tier words, never an em dash.

groups.title: See it clearly
groups.line: Find out what’s actually broken before you pay to fix it.
groups.note: Two free checks, about two minutes each. The diagnostic names the pattern you’re in. The engine check reads the team you lead.

picker.headline: Something’s off, and I can’t name it
picker.sub: Two free checks, about two minutes each

cards.name: Free diagnostic
cards.desc: A few short questions, about two minutes, and which of five patterns is loudest for you right now: Bottleneck, Growth Gap, Drift, Stall or New Seat.
cards.label: See the diagnostic

cards.name: Engine check
cards.desc: Eighteen statements about the team you lead, answered on instinct in about two minutes, and a readout across the six cylinders of CREATE.
cards.label: See the engine check

cards.name: Psychological Safety Check
cards.desc: Seven statements built on Amy Edmondson’s scale. Take it yourself or send it to your team, free and with no email needed. Inside the OBD, it becomes a 360 on how safe your team feels with you.
cards.label: See the Safety Check

quote.text: I run a real dashboard for a living. I came in skeptical of the metaphor – I left with a usable distinction between what’s actually a leading indicator and what’s just a soft signal I’d have noticed anyway.

groups.title: Develop one leader
groups.line: When one leader’s next step would move the whole organization.

picker.headline: One leader needs to grow into the job

cards.name: On-Board Diagnostic
cards.desc: CliftonStrengths® and EQ-i 2.0 read against each other, and written up as one document about how this leader works under pressure.

quote.text: I thought I needed better time management. Turns out I needed to get out of my own way.

cards.label: See the OBD

cards.name: Executive coaching
cards.desc: Six structured sessions built on your OBD, so session one starts from a read rather than an introduction. Coaching and consulting, named in the room.
facts: One leader, with a completed OBD

quote.text: Matt called me on it. Not rudely, but he wasn’t going to let me pretend the problem was my employees.

cards.label: See executive coaching

groups.title: Grow a cohort
groups.line: When several people are stepping into bigger seats at once.

picker.headline: Several people stepping up at once
picker.sub: A cohort for a new seat or the next one

cards.name: GoodeStart
cards.desc: The first ninety days in a new seat, done on purpose: an assessment baseline, four coaching sessions and a thirteen-week cohort.
cards.label: See GoodeStart

cards.name: Building the Bench
cards.desc: Six months with a cohort of leaders at the same altitude, getting ready for the next seat and becoming each other’s first call.
cards.label: See Building the Bench

quote.text: His work reinforced something fundamental: a strong school isn’t built around a handful of exceptional leaders, but around a culture where leadership can flourish at every level.

groups.title: Workshops for the team
groups.line: When everyone works hard, just not in the same direction.

picker.headline: Good people, pulling in different directions
picker.sub: Workshops for one team or a whole staff

cards.name: Know Thyself to Lead Others
cards.tier: Team workshop · Schools edition · Organizations edition
cards.desc: A three-hour strengths workshop built on everyone’s CliftonStrengths report, so a whole staff learns how each person does their best work.
facts: A department or whole staff, up to fifty
cards.label: See Know Thyself

cards.name: Owner’s Manual
cards.tier: A Know Thyself to Lead Others module
cards.desc: Each person turns their OBD into a manual for how they work, then the team swaps, so nobody has to guess how anyone else operates.
facts: A small daily team, up to fifteen
cards.label: See the Owner’s Manual

cards.name: OWN
cards.desc: Strengths-based advisory design for schools. Teachers and advisors learn to ask, so students OWN the meaning – not you.
cards.label: See OWN

cards.name: Hand Over the Keys
cards.desc: Ninety minutes on how to hand work over so it stays handed over: the eight steps of DELEGATE, and one change your team can make on Monday.
cards.label: See Hand Over the Keys

cards.name: Decision rights
cards.desc: A working session, then a written map of which decisions belong where. Decided before the meeting rather than during it.
cards.label: See the 6C session

cards.name: Field Tested
cards.desc: A half or full day in person with your facilitators, modelling the methods from Field Tested, with a sixty-day lead-up and follow-up at thirty and ninety days.
cards.label: See Field Tested

quote.text: Most people assume you can hire fast and fire decisively. My world can’t. What I appreciated is that the core framework still held up once I did the translation myself, and Matt’s workshop does that translation for you.
